ai.title: National intelligence director Jay Clayton to lead AI task force
ai.description: President Donald Trump on Sunday tapped Jay Clayton, his director of national intelligence, to lead a new government task force on artificial intelligence.
ai.title_cn: 美国国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿将领导AI工作组
ai.description_cn: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周日任命他的国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿领导一个新的政府人工智能特别工作组。

ai.title: Trump launches ‘Super Intelligence Force’ after calls for AI slowdown
ai.description: President Donald Trump announced Sunday that he would name four top administration officials to a “Super Intelligence Force” that will coordinate the federal government’s response to artificial intelligence. Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton, Federal Trade Commission Chairman Andrew Ferguson, Office of Personnel Management Director Scott Kupor and Emil Michael, undersecretary of war for research and engineering, will lead the task force, Trump said.
ai.title_cn: 特朗普在呼吁人工智能放缓后推出“超级情报部队”
ai.description_cn: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周日宣布，他将任命四名高级政府官员组成“超级情报部队”，该部队将协调联邦政府对人工智能的应对措施。特朗普表示，国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿、联邦贸易委员会主席安德鲁·弗格森、人事管理办公室主任斯科特·库普尔和负责研究和工程的战争副部长埃米尔·迈克尔将领导该特别工作组。

ai.title: Elon Musk says SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI after Trump's 'super intelligence' push
ai.description: The plan comes days after Trump signed an executive order directing federal agencies to use the term. The order, signed on September 29, 2026, replaces "artificial intelligence" with "Super Intelligence," or "SI," on official websites, policy documents and government press releases.
ai.title_cn: 埃隆·马斯克表示，在特朗普推动“超级智能”后，SpaceXAI将更名为SpaceXSI
ai.description_cn: 该计划是在特朗普签署一项行政命令后制定的，指示联邦机构使用该术语。该命令于2026年9月29日签署，在官方网站、政策文件和政府新闻稿中将“人工智能”替换为“超级智能”或“SI”。

ai.title: Trump announces U.S. ‘Super Intelligence Force’ on AI

ai.title_cn: 特朗普宣布美国在人工智能上建立“超级情报部队”
ai.description_cn: 唐纳德·特朗普总统任命他的国家情报总监杰伊·克莱顿领导一个新的人工智能政府工作组。

ai.title: After White House accord, Trump announces formation of Super Intelligence Force to ‘ensure US lead in AI’
ai.description: Trump, who rechristened artificial intelligence as “super intelligence” last month, has earlier dismissed risks associated with the tech.
ai.title_cn: 白宫达成协议后，特朗普宣布组建超级情报部队，以“确保美国在人工智能领域的领先地位”
ai.description_cn: 特朗普上个月将人工智能重新命名为“超级智能”，他早些时候曾否认与该技术相关的风险。
